fullContentHtml:
KGMU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : King George’s Medical University Uttar Pradesh KGMU Lucknow has released the notification for the post of Various Non Teaching Group B and Group C. This recruitment has been issued for 332 posts. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official Sarkari Result 2025 website which is SarkariExam.com. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 17 November 2024
  • Application Start Date : 11 December 2024
  • Last Date : 03 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 March 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC  : Rs. 2360/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1416/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Important Links

  • Apply OnlineApply Online
  • Official WebsiteOfficial Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is KGMU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2025?

KGMU Non Teaching Various Post Online Form 2025 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 03 March 2025.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.kgmu.org/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
